attribution: Draken RPG Maps — unofficial Night City 2020 map, derived from R. Talsorian Games plans
method: Closed dark-outline detection, interior source-fill classification, polygon contour tracing and small printed-artifact suppression; no synthetic geometry.
limitations: Building masses and urban blocks follow the source regional illustration; individual silhouettes are not certified cadastral building boundaries.
Printed location marks and labels can obscure parts of source footprints. Some source contours may be incomplete.
